title: Passiv im will future & going to future

instruction.text: Ordne die Zeitformen ihren Passivbildungen zu.

trainers.layout:
a1 b1
a2 b2
a3 b3

atoms.b: ((++Will_future Going_to_future))
((Will_future ++Going_to_future))
will be + past participle
am/is/are going to be + past participle
My room will be cleaned after this weekend.
My friend is going to be asked for a date.

instruction.text: Schiebe die Passivbildungen und Beispielsätze zur richtigen Zeitform.

atoms.b: will be + past participle
am/is/are going to be + past participle
atoms.sound: am, is, are. going to be plus past participle

atoms.b: Their kitchen is going to be renovated next year.
Rahim will be invited to the party.

instruction.text: Bringe die Teile der Passivkonstruktion in die richtige Reihenfolge.

atoms.a: Meine Kleidung wird von mir genäht werden, wenn sie reißt.
atoms.b: My clothes ((will)) ((be)) ((sewn)) by me if they tear.

atoms.a: Wir müssen unseren ökologischen Fußabdruck verbessern, sonst wird die Erde, die wir kennen, durch uns zerstört.
atoms.b: We must improve our carbon footprint, otherwise the earth we know ((will)) ((be)) ((destroyed)) by us.

atoms.a: All unsere Orchesterinstrumente werden gebraucht gekauft werden, um Geld und Ressourcen zu sparen.
atoms.b: All our orchestra instruments ((are)) ((going)) ((to)) ((be)) ((bought)) second hand to save money and resources.

atoms.a: Ich bin sicher, dass ich zum Team-Kapitän gewählt werde.
atoms.b: I am sure that I ((am)) ((going)) ((to)) ((be)) ((elected)) team captain.

instruction.text: Schreibe die Passivform in der gegebenen Zeitform in die Lücke.

atoms.b: His grandfather's flowers ((will_be_watered)) if Lionel remembers to do it.
The new book ((will_be_read)) by the class when they finished their current topic.
I hope our bathroom ((will_be_renovated)) by the time I celebrate my 16th birthday.
The wedding ceromony ((is_going_to_be_held)) in the local church on Saturday.
Sarina's holidays with her friends ((are_going_to_be_paid)) by her parents.
Their weekly outdoor basketball match ((is_going_to_be_cancelled)) because the coach has caught a cold.
